info.title: Kiln HTTP API
info.description: Canonical inventory of every production HTTP route, method, transport, handler owner, request type, response type, status, media type, path/header/query input, and structured error envelope. Every named payload component delegates its complete field contract to a canonical generated schema. Kiln does not authenticate HTTP requests. The server binds to loopback by default; put any remotely accessible deployment behind an authenticated reverse proxy on a trusted network.

AdapterDetail.description: Adapter file inventory plus retained training, evaluation, and lineage evidence.

AdapterUploadMultipart.description: Multipart adapter installation body. Unknown parts are drained and ignored.

AdaptersResponse.description: The complete resident and on-disk adapter registry view.

DeleteAdapterResponse.description: Confirmation that an adapter directory was deleted.

DeleteExportResponse.description: Confirmation that an immutable export bundle was deleted.

DeleteTeacherResponse.description: Confirmation that a teacher alias was removed.

ExportDetail.description: An export summary plus its full self-verifying handoff manifest.

ExportList.description: All immutable HF/TRL exports currently retained by the server.

GrpoExportRequest.description: Create an immutable GRPO handoff from exactly one inline or filesystem source.

ImportPeftResponse.description: The verified external PEFT result installed into Kiln's adapter registry.

JsonValue.description: Arbitrary JSON is the complete intentional wire shape for this operation.

JsonValueArray.description: Array of arbitrary JSON values is the complete intentional wire shape for this operation.

LoadAdapterRequest.description: Load an installed adapter, optionally overriding quarantine admission or forcing the already-live exact on-disk revision through a between-requests reload.

LoadAdapterResponse.description: Confirmation that an exact adapter revision is live.

MergeAdapterRequest.description: Create an immutable merged adapter. Density is accepted only for TIES and defaults to 0.2 there.

RegisterTeacherRequest.description: Caller-controlled teacher registration fields. Identity, capabilities, and secret environment names are rejected.

SftExportRequest.description: Create an immutable SFT handoff from exactly one inline, filesystem, or named-dataset source.

TeacherEntry.description: A persisted teacher plus its resolved identity, capabilities, and usability state.

UnloadAdapterResponse.description: Confirmation that the runtime adapter is unloaded.

UploadAdapterResponse.description: The atomically installed adapter archive summary.

kiln_train_AdapterReceipt.description: Legacy adapter audit receipt. It supports drift analysis, not exact replay.
